strength.name: Incline DB Press
strength.old_cue: Bench ~30°, lower to the upper chest with elbows slightly in, press up and slightly together.
strength.new_cue: Bench ~30°, shoulder blades pinned. Lower to the upper chest, forearms vertical; press up and slightly in. Don't flare the elbows out to 90°.
strength.equipment_note: Needs a bench / rack / dedicated machine not on the Marcy; cue phrased generically.

strength.name: Flat DB Press
strength.old_cue: Shoulder blades back and down, elbows ~45°, both sides press evenly.
strength.new_cue: Shoulder blades back and down, feet planted. Lower to mid-chest, elbows ~45°, press up evenly. Don't bounce or arch the lower back.
strength.equipment_note: Needs a bench / rack / dedicated machine not on the Marcy; cue phrased generically.

strength.name: Chest Press Machine
strength.old_cue: Handles at mid-chest, chest up, press out without shrugging; squeeze at full extension.
strength.new_cue: Set the seat so the handles sit at mid-chest, back flat on the pad. Press out, elbows ~45°, slow return. Don't shrug or let the stack rest between reps.

strength.name: Cable Chest Fly
strength.old_cue: Soft bend in the elbows, hug an arc, bring the hands together in front of the chest.
strength.new_cue: Slight forward lean, soft fixed elbow bend. Sweep the hands together in a wide arc in front of the chest. Don't bend the elbows into a press.

strength.name: Machine Shoulder Press
strength.old_cue: Brace, lower to about chin height, press overhead without arching the back.
strength.new_cue: Handles at shoulder height, back flat on the pad, core braced. Press overhead, lower to chin level. Don't arch the lower back off the pad.
strength.equipment_note: Needs a bench / rack / dedicated machine not on the Marcy; cue phrased generically.

strength.name: DB Lateral Raises
strength.old_cue: Lead with the elbows out to the side up to shoulder height; no swinging.
strength.new_cue: Brace, slight elbow bend. Lead with the elbows out to shoulder height, lower slowly. Don't swing the body or shrug the shoulders.

strength.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
strength.old_cue: Elbows pinned at your sides, extend fully and pause at the bottom.
strength.new_cue: High pulley. Elbows pinned to your sides, push down to full extension, control the return. Don't lean over the bar or let the elbows drift.

strength.name: Overhead Rope Extension
strength.old_cue: Rope behind the head, upper arms still, extend straight up for a full stretch-to-lockout.
strength.new_cue: Rope behind the head, elbows by the ears and still. Extend straight up, lower to a full stretch. Don't flare the elbows or arch the back.

strength.name: Triceps Dips / Dip Machine
strength.old_cue: Upright torso, lower to ~90° at the elbow, press back up under control. Weight = added kg (negative = assistance).
strength.new_cue: Torso upright, elbows back and close. Lower to ~90° at the elbow, press up under control. Don't sink so deep the shoulders roll forward.
strength.new_cue_full: Torso upright, elbows back and close. Lower to ~90° at the elbow, press up under control. Don't sink so deep the shoulders roll forward. Weight = added kg (negative = assistance).
strength.equipment_note: Needs a bench / rack / dedicated machine not on the Marcy; cue phrased generically.

strength.name: Lat Pulldown
strength.old_cue: Chest tall, drive the elbows down toward the ribs; no leaning back or momentum.
strength.new_cue: Sit tall, slight lean back. Pull the bar to the upper chest, driving the elbows down to the ribs. Don't yank with momentum or lean further back.

strength.name: Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)
strength.old_cue: Palms facing, pull the elbows down and slightly forward while the chest stays up.
strength.new_cue: Palms facing, chest up. Drive the elbows down to your sides, handle to the upper chest, slow return. Don't shrug up at the top.

strength.name: Chest-Supported Row
strength.old_cue: Chest on the pad, row to the lower chest and squeeze the shoulder blades together.
strength.new_cue: Chest on the pad, arms long. Row the elbows back to the lower ribs, squeeze the shoulder blades. Don't lift the chest off the pad to heave.
strength.equipment_note: Needs a bench / rack / dedicated machine not on the Marcy; cue phrased generically.

strength.name: Seated Row
strength.old_cue: Sit tall, row the handle to the belly button, slow and controlled return.
strength.new_cue: Low pulley, sit tall, knees soft. Row the handle to the belly, elbows close, squeeze; slow return. Don't rock the torso back and forth.

strength.name: Rear Delt Fly
strength.old_cue: Arms move out wide, feel the back of the shoulders; keep the traps down.
strength.new_cue: Light weight, soft elbows. Sweep the arms out wide to shoulder height, shoulders down. Don't shrug or go heavy enough to need momentum.

strength.name: Dumbbell Curls
strength.old_cue: Elbows by your sides, palms up, slow curl and a full squeeze at the top.
strength.new_cue: Elbows by your sides, palms up. Curl toward the shoulders, lower to straight arms. Don't swing the torso or let the elbows drift forward.

strength.name: Incline DB Curls
strength.old_cue: Arms hang behind you for a full stretch, curl slowly, no swinging.
strength.new_cue: Bench 45–60°, arms hang straight down. Curl without moving the upper arm, lower to a full stretch. Don't let the elbows swing forward.
strength.equipment_note: Needs a bench / rack / dedicated machine not on the Marcy; cue phrased generically.

strength.name: Cable Bicep Curls
strength.old_cue: Elbows fixed, smooth curl, squeeze at the top, control the way down.
strength.new_cue: Low pulley, stand tall. Elbows fixed at your sides, curl up, squeeze, lower under control. Don't lean back or let the shoulders rise.

strength.name: Back Squat
strength.old_cue: Brace the core, sit down under control, drive up through the whole foot.
strength.new_cue: Brace, bar over mid-foot. Sit down between the hips, knees tracking over the toes; drive up through the whole foot. Don't let the knees cave in.
strength.equipment_note: Needs a bench / rack / dedicated machine not on the Marcy; cue phrased generically.

strength.name: Hack Squat
strength.old_cue: Back flat on the pad, controlled descent, push through the whole foot.
strength.new_cue: Back and hips flat on the pad, feet shoulder-width. Lower under control, drive through the whole foot. Don't let the hips peel off the pad.
strength.equipment_note: Needs a bench / rack / dedicated machine not on the Marcy; cue phrased generically.

strength.name: Leg Press
strength.old_cue: Feet mid-platform, knees to ~90°, never lock out at the top.
strength.new_cue: Back and hips flat on the seat, feet mid-platform. Lower to ~90° at the knee, press through the whole foot. Don't lock the knees at the top.
strength.equipment_note: Needs a bench / rack / dedicated machine not on the Marcy; cue phrased generically.

strength.name: Leg Extension
strength.old_cue: Lift with the quads, pause at the top, lower slowly.
strength.new_cue: Line the knee up with the pivot, pad on the lower shin. Extend fully, pause, lower slowly. Don't kick the weight up or let the stack slam.

strength.name: Hamstring Curl
strength.old_cue: Hips stay down, curl smoothly, squeeze at full flexion.
strength.new_cue: Knee in line with the pivot, pad just above the heel. Curl smoothly, squeeze, lower slowly. Don't lift the hips or swing the weight up.

strength.name: Calf Raise
strength.old_cue: On a step: full stretch at the bottom, push through the big toe, slow descent. Weight = added kg (dumbbell in hand).
strength.new_cue: Balls of the feet on a step. Drop the heels for a full stretch, rise as high as you can, lower slowly. Don't bounce at the bottom.
strength.new_cue_full: Balls of the feet on a step. Drop the heels for a full stretch, rise as high as you can, lower slowly. Don't bounce at the bottom. Weight = added kg (dumbbell in hand).

strength.name: Pec Deck (Butterfly)
strength.old_cue: Back flat on the pad, elbows slightly bent, squeeze the arms together in front of the chest, slow return.
strength.new_cue: Set the seat so the elbows sit at shoulder height, back flat on the pad. Squeeze the arms together, pause, slow return. Don't arch or use momentum.

strength.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
strength.old_cue: Sit on the Marcy seat, back on the pad; lower to ear height, press up without arching.
strength.new_cue: Sit on the Marcy seat, back on the pad. Lower to ear height, wrists over the elbows, press straight up. Don't arch the lower back off the pad.

strength.name: Half-Kneeling Cable Press
strength.old_cue: Low pulley, kneel on the side of the working arm, ribs down, press up and slightly forward.
strength.new_cue: Low pulley, kneel on the working-arm side; squeeze that glute, ribs down. Press up and slightly forward. Don't lean back or arch to finish.

strength.name: Cable Lateral Raise
strength.old_cue: Low pulley, handle in the far hand, raise out to the side to shoulder height; no swinging.
strength.new_cue: Low pulley, handle in the far hand, elbow slightly bent. Raise out to shoulder height, lower slowly. Don't swing or lean away from the cable.

strength.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
strength.old_cue: Low pulley, brace, row the elbow back past the ribs, full stretch forward on the return.
strength.new_cue: Low pulley, brace. Row the elbow back past the ribs, then reach forward for a full stretch. Don't twist the torso to finish the rep.

strength.name: Face Pull
strength.old_cue: High pulley at face height, pull toward the forehead with the elbows high and wide, squeeze the rear delts.
strength.new_cue: High pulley, rope at face height, thumbs back. Pull to the forehead, elbows high, spreading the rope apart. Don't lean back or shrug.

strength.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
strength.old_cue: Face away from the low pulley, arm behind you for a full stretch, curl without moving the elbow forward.
strength.new_cue: Back to the low pulley, staggered stance, arm behind you. Curl without moving the elbow forward; full stretch on the way down. Don't swing.

strength.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
strength.old_cue: Rear foot on the Marcy seat, drop straight down, front knee tracks over the toes; drive up through the front foot. Weight = dumbbells in hand.
strength.new_cue: Rear foot on the Marcy seat. Drop straight down, front shin near vertical; drive up through the front foot. Don't let the front knee cave in.
strength.new_cue_full: Rear foot on the Marcy seat. Drop straight down, front shin near vertical; drive up through the front foot. Don't let the front knee cave in. Weight = dumbbells in hand.

strength.name: Goblet Squat
strength.old_cue: Dumbbell against the chest, sit between the heels, chest up, push through the whole foot.
strength.new_cue: Dumbbell at the chest, elbows in. Sit between the heels, chest up, knees over the toes; stand through the whole foot. Don't round the lower back.

strength.name: Cable Squat
strength.old_cue: Hold the low-pulley handle at the chest, lean back slightly against the cable, squeeze down and drive up.
strength.new_cue: Low pulley, handle at the chest. Sit the hips down and back, torso upright, drive up through the whole foot. Don't lean back into a hip hinge.

strength.name: Close-Grip Push-up
strength.old_cue: Hands under the shoulders, elbows brushing the ribs, body straight; knees down to make it easier.
strength.new_cue: Hands under the shoulders, elbows brushing the ribs, body in one line. Knees down to make it easier. Don't let the hips sag.

strength.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
strength.old_cue: Face away from the high pulley (bar or rope), upper arms by the ears, extend to lockout, full stretch back.
strength.new_cue: Face away from the high pulley, staggered stance, upper arms by the ears. Extend to lockout, return to a full stretch. Don't flare the elbows.

notes: STRENGTH: all 35 EX entries in src/services/strength.ts (fields: id, name, muscles, bodyweightFrac?, cue?, video? via VIDEOS map, custom?). new_cue is the form cue only (<=160 chars, ends with a 'Don't ...'). For triceps_dips, calf_raise and bulgarian_split_squat the current cue carries an app-functional 'Weight = ...' instruction that is NOT a form cue; it is given as keep_suffix and new_cue_full = new_cue + suffix (these exceed 160 by design). Behaviour changes worth noting: cable_squat old cue said 'lean back slightly against the cable', which the sources call a mistake (it turns into a hinge), so it is reversed; back_squat/leg_press/hack_squat now say 'knees over toes / don't cave' and 'don't lock out'; rear_delt_fly now warns against shrugging and pinching the shoulder blades. Machine cues are phrased for the Marcy (seat/pad height, pivot alignment, 'don't let the stack slam/rest', high vs low pulley). Exercises flagged equipment_note need a bench, rack or dedicated machine Geert's Marcy lacks, so those cues are generic. Every strength row's sources include its existing VIDEOS YouTube link (title-only reference). CARDIO: there is NO structured cardio exercise DB. Items live in (a) src/services/coachFiles.ts DEFAULT_DRILLS (7 drills) and DEFAULT_STRENGTH (8 runner strength moves), both markdown strings seeded once as editable knowledge files ('pre-run-drills', 'strength-exercises'). The device copies may have been edited and are not in the repo, so updating the defaults only affects fresh installs or files never seeded unless a migration re-seeds or appends. (b) src/services/workoutLibrary.ts seed(): 30 LibraryWorkout entries (id, name, kind, warmupMeters, drillsMinutes, cooldownMeters, blocks[], notes?, updatedAt). There is no cue field; `notes` (the UI placeholder reads 'Cues, goal pace, focus…') is the natural home. The cues are given per session TYPE, and the 'where' text maps each type to its seed ids. The seed only runs when the library file does not exist, so existing installs need a migration to pick them up. (c) coach.ts WatchWorkout/WorkoutStructure has only warmupMeters/drillsMinutes/cooldownMeters numbers and carries no exercise text. Cues are written in my own words (no copied text, no brand names, no medical claims). Effort cues ('conversational', 'comfortably hard') are paired with the app's HR zones in the id_or_name. Weak sourcing: race-pace reps have no dedicated source (only general pacing guidance), and the long-run row has one source. Some URLs are aggregator pages (fitbod, liftosaur, strengthlog) where ACE, ExRx or NSCA had no matching page.
